{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = data.duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate rows: {duplicates}')

# Check the distribution of 'arm'
arm_distribution = data['arm'].value_counts()
print(f'Arm distribution:\n{arm_distribution}')

# Check the distribution of 'responded' in the treatment arm
treatment_responded = data[data['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].value_counts()
print(f'Responded in treatment arm:\n{treatment_responded}')"}
